summary: Wrote research/context.md in complete mode (no reference-only authorization exists): All Saints (F02) wins 1 November 2026 under RG 91 row 11 with the Twenty-third Sunday after Pentecost commemorated in all three orations, read on 200/400-dpi images of the hash-matched 1962 facsimile (pp. 702-703, nos. 3974-3983; Sunday orations pp. 416-417, nos. 1720, 1726, 1728) and checked against dated ICRSP, FSSP and FSSPX ordos, with a complete fourteen-element inventory, Ordinary texts, Clementine wording differences, lawful Latin and English routes, shared-record defects and a research task list keyed to the handoff leads. This dispatch contributed the settled occurrence and inventory for the revision, including the unresolved Trinity-versus-common Preface named with both rubrical bases, the ICRSP last-Gospel conflict with RGMR 509, and an OCR-level confirmation that the 1570 Offertory reads tormentum mortis without alleluia.
